english: Online schools may reduce school-related expenses and be more cost-effective because they need fewer bricks-and-mortar facilities and less spending on cleaning and maintenance.
chinese: 在线学校可能减少上学相关开销，更具成本效益，因为它们需要的实体设施更少，清洁和维护支出也更低。

english: Flexible home education may help parents take better care of children with physical disabilities or learning disabilities.
chinese: 灵活的家庭教育可能帮助家长更好地照顾有身体残疾或学习障碍的孩子。

english: Lower social or peer pressure may give children more confidence to express their true selves.
chinese: 较低的社交或同伴压力可能让孩子更有信心表达真实的自己。

english: Spending quality time with family members can improve mutual understanding.
chinese: 与家人共度优质时光可以增进相互理解。

english: Online learning can help students get familiar with common software and learn to collaborate remotely, which may improve their employability.
chinese: 在线学习可以帮助学生熟悉常用软件并学会远程合作，从而可能提高就业能力。

english: Reducing excessive competitive pressure may boost students' self-esteem and motivation to learn.
chinese: 减轻过度的竞争压力可能提高学生的自尊心和学习动力。

english: Students can arrange study time according to personal preference, creating favourable conditions for learning while avoiding overwork.
chinese: 学生可以按照个人偏好安排学习时间，创造有利的学习条件，同时避免过度劳累。

english: Tailor-made teaching methods can reflect a child's learning habits and help the child learn at an optimal level.
chinese: 量身定制的教学方法可以适应孩子的学习习惯，帮助孩子达到更好的学习状态。

english: Home education can allow for a more flexible schedule, giving students the freedom to adjust their study arrangements.
chinese: 家庭教育可以让时间安排更加灵活，使学生能够自由调整学习计划。

english: A flexible timetable can give children ample time to pursue their own hobbies and interests.
chinese: 灵活的时间表可以让孩子有充足的时间追求自己的爱好和兴趣。

english: The wider use of the Internet and advances in machine learning software may help educational tools respond to an individual's strengths and weaknesses.
chinese: 互联网使用的扩大和机器学习软件的进步，可能帮助教育工具更好地适应个人的优势与不足。

english: Face-to-face activities give students more opportunities to interact with peers and form friendships.
chinese: 面对面活动让学生有更多机会与同龄人互动并建立友谊。

english: Encouragement from classmates and teachers can improve students' confidence.
chinese: 同学和老师的鼓励可以增强学生的信心。

english: Regular participation in physical education and outdoor activities is conducive to physical health.
chinese: 定期参加体育课和户外活动有益于身体健康。

english: Support from teachers and classmates may relieve anxiety and help students cope with psychological problems.
chinese: 老师和同学的支持可能缓解焦虑，并帮助学生应对心理问题。

english: Schools can encourage students to eat less junk food and adopt healthy eating habits.
chinese: 学校可以鼓励学生少吃垃圾食品，养成健康的饮食习惯。

english: Group activities can cultivate team spirit and improve students' ability to cooperate.
chinese: 小组活动可以培养团队精神，提高学生的合作能力。

english: Learning to consider other people's feelings and deal with conflicts can improve students' social skills.
chinese: 学会考虑他人的感受和处理冲突，可以提高学生的社交能力。

english: A classroom with few distractions can provide an ideal learning atmosphere.
chinese: 干扰较少的教室可以提供理想的学习氛围。

english: Supportive classmates and effective teacher supervision can help students complete tasks on time and make progress.
chinese: 支持性的同伴关系和有效的教师监督，可以帮助学生按时完成任务并取得进步。

english: A systematic teaching plan can assist students in reviewing regularly and consolidating what they have learned.
chinese: 系统的教学计划可以帮助学生定期复习并巩固所学知识。

english: Teaching basic social rules, including punctuality and honesty, can help regulate students' behaviour.
chinese: 教授守时、诚实等基本社会准则，可以帮助规范学生的行为。

english: Group discussion gives students opportunities to practise expressing their ideas.
chinese: 小组讨论为学生提供练习表达观点的机会。

english: Understanding job market demand helps schools provide training that addresses students' future needs.
chinese: 了解就业市场需求，有助于学校根据学生未来的需要提供有针对性的培训。

english: Students can learn from each other's perspectives and consider problems from different angles.
chinese: 学生可以学习彼此的观点，从不同角度思考问题。

english: Legal education at school can enhance students' safety awareness.
chinese: 学校的法律教育可以提高学生的安全意识。

english: Education can help students develop logical thinking, a rational attitude and analytical skills.
chinese: 教育可以帮助学生培养逻辑思维、理性态度和分析能力。

english: Students learn to analyse and interpret data by applying mathematics and computational thinking.
chinese: 学生通过运用数学和计算思维，学习分析和解释数据。

english: Technical education can help students master cutting-edge technology and keep up to date with new developments.
chinese: 技术教育可以帮助学生掌握前沿技术，及时了解新的发展。

english: Schools can provide vocational training that helps students develop expertise in a particular field.
chinese: 学校可以提供职业培训，帮助学生积累某个领域的专业知识。

english: Suitable learning tasks can help students become better at multi-tasking and tackling difficult mental tasks.
chinese: 适当的学习任务可以帮助学生更好地处理多项任务和具有挑战性的脑力工作。

english: Clear expectations and respectful guidance can improve students' behaviour and help them develop good manners.
chinese: 明确的要求和尊重学生的指导，可以改善学生行为，帮助他们养成良好的礼仪。

english: Students can learn to think critically by examining and understanding different perspectives.
chinese: 学生可以通过审视和理解不同观点，学习批判性思考。

english: Open-ended projects can develop imaginative skills, creative thinking and originality.
chinese: 开放式项目可以培养想象力、创造性思维和独创性。

english: A shared sense of cultural identity and nationhood may unite people when it also respects differences within society.
chinese: 共同的文化认同感和民族意识，在尊重社会内部差异的前提下，可能团结人们。

english: Cross-cultural education can increase awareness and understanding, helping students become more open-minded and tolerant of different ideas.
chinese: 跨文化教育可以增进认识和理解，帮助学生更加开放并包容不同的想法。

english: Studying the Great Depression can help students understand the importance of social welfare programmes.
chinese: 研究大萧条可以帮助学生理解社会福利计划的重要性。

english: Students can learn practical ways to relieve pressure and cope with stress.
chinese: 学生可以学习缓解压力和应对压力的实用方法。

english: A broad curriculum can help children develop their potential and discover their interests.
chinese: 广泛的课程可以帮助孩子发展潜力、发现兴趣。

english: Completing a challenging task can build confidence and give students a sense of achievement.
chinese: 完成一项具有挑战性的任务，可以增强学生的信心并带来成就感。

english: Education can foster empathy and compassion while preparing well-educated people for skilled work that helps boost the economy.
chinese: 教育可以培养同理心和同情心，同时为受过良好教育的人从事技术性工作做好准备，从而支持经济发展。

english: Sound, images and visual effects can gain attention, maintain students' interest and stimulate enthusiasm for learning.
chinese: 声音、图像和视觉效果可以吸引注意力、保持学生兴趣并激发学习热情。

english: Studying economics and political theory can help students understand how society operates.
chinese: 学习经济学和政治理论，可以帮助学生理解社会如何运行。

english: Civic education can teach students to respect others, value fairness and actively participate in social activities.
chinese: 公民教育可以教学生尊重他人、重视公平并积极参与社会活动。

english: Watching suitable programmes or playing games in moderation may develop interests and inspire further reading on a topic.
chinese: 适度观看合适的节目或玩游戏，可能培养兴趣，并激发对某个主题的进一步阅读。

english: Educational media can help students gain extracurricular knowledge and access a broad range of information.
chinese: 教育媒体可以帮助学生获得课外知识，接触广泛的信息。

english: Educational programmes can go beyond subject knowledge to cover social issues closely related to the real world.
chinese: 教育节目可以超越学科知识，涵盖与现实世界密切相关的社会问题。

english: Well-designed activities can improve literacy levels by raising children's phonological awareness.
chinese: 设计良好的活动可以通过提高儿童的语音意识，帮助提升读写能力。

english: Learning to communicate with others online develops a practical skill that students may use in their future work.
chinese: 学习在线与他人交流，可以培养学生未来工作中可能用到的一项实用技能。

english: Students can become familiar with everyday computer tasks, such as downloading programmes and installing software.
chinese: 学生可以熟悉下载程序、安装软件等日常电脑操作。

english: Students need to navigate the Internet effectively to complete assignments and conduct research.
chinese: 学生需要有效地浏览互联网，以完成作业和开展研究。

english: Receiving information passively may reduce active mental engagement and leave fewer opportunities for creative thinking.
chinese: 被动接收信息可能减少主动思考，让创造性思维得到锻炼的机会变少。

english: When media present every detail directly, they may leave little room for imagination and limit opportunities to develop imaginative skills.
chinese: 当媒体直接呈现所有细节时，可能留给想象的空间很少，并限制想象力得到锻炼的机会。

english: Reading asks people to infer images from words, exercising imagination and creativity in ways that may be less necessary when watching television.
chinese: 阅读要求人们从文字推想画面，以观看电视时可能较少需要的方式锻炼想象力和创造力。

english: A lack of opportunities to produce language can make it harder to improve speaking and writing skills.
chinese: 缺少语言输出机会，会使提高口语和写作能力变得更加困难。

english: Games that require only short-term focus may make sustained classroom attention harder for some children, but this alone does not establish that games cause attention deficit disorders.
chinese: 只需短期注意力的游戏，可能使部分孩子更难在课堂上持续专注，但仅凭这一点不能认定游戏会导致注意缺陷障碍。

english: Teachers who rely entirely on multimedia may overlook important parts of the curriculum.
chinese: 完全依赖多媒体的教师，可能忽略课程中的重要内容。

english: Heavily commercialised programmes may encourage impulsive buying.
chinese: 商业化程度很高的节目可能诱发冲动消费。

english: Targeted advertising on Internet platforms may create artificial desires or needs among children.
chinese: 互联网平台上的定向广告，可能在儿童中制造人为的欲望或需求。

english: Prolonged gaming can involve repetitive, strenuous movements of the hands and wrists, which may contribute to inflammation or injury.
chinese: 长时间玩游戏可能涉及手和腕部重复、费力的动作，从而增加发炎或受伤的风险。

english: Excessive screen time may reduce time for sleep and exercise, contributing to poorer physical health.
chinese: 过度使用屏幕可能减少睡眠和运动时间，从而损害身体健康。

english: An economic revival may make some workers less concerned about job security.
chinese: 经济复苏可能使一些劳动者不再那么担忧工作稳定性。

english: Emerging industries can create new jobs.
chinese: 新兴产业可以创造新的就业岗位。

english: A recovering job market may offer workers more opportunities to change careers.
chinese: 正在回暖的就业市场，可能为劳动者提供更多转行机会。

english: A well-paid job can increase employees' purchasing power beyond basic needs such as food and accommodation.
chinese: 高薪工作可以提高员工在食物、住房等基本需求之外的购买力。

english: A more specialised division of labour may create clearer career pathways and make switching jobs less challenging for some workers.
chinese: 更加专业化的劳动分工，可能形成更清晰的职业路径，使部分劳动者换工作更加容易。

english: Technological advancement can eliminate some low-skilled positions while creating demand for new skills.
chinese: 技术进步可能淘汰一些低技能岗位，同时创造对新技能的需求。

english: Excessively long commuting times may encourage employees to look for work closer to home.
chinese: 过长的通勤时间可能促使员工寻找离家更近的工作。

english: Switching jobs can help people identify a career path that better suits their interests and abilities.
chinese: 换工作可以帮助人们找到更符合其兴趣和能力的职业道路。

english: Workers whose previous jobs were seasonal or temporary may seek full-time employment for greater stability.
chinese: 此前从事季节性或临时工作的劳动者，可能为了更加稳定而寻找全职工作。

english: When a company is restructured, some departments may be eliminated.
chinese: 公司重组时，一些部门可能被撤销。

english: When a company downsizes, employees who lack the required qualifications may have their contracts terminated.
chinese: 公司裁员时，不具备所需资历的员工可能遭到解约。

english: Labour mobility can support a more efficient allocation of the workforce.
chinese: 劳动力流动可以支持人力资源更加有效的配置。

english: Companies can use headhunting to recruit more experienced workers.
chinese: 公司可以通过猎头招聘更有经验的员工。

english: Employees may consider leaving when their personal values no longer align with organisational goals.
chinese: 当个人价值观不再与组织目标一致时，员工可能考虑离职。

english: Frequent unexplained job changes may weaken a candidate's CV because some employers prefer applicants with a record of stability.
chinese: 频繁且缺乏合理解释的跳槽，可能削弱简历的说服力，因为一些雇主偏好工作经历稳定的申请者。

english: Greater population mobility can create new challenges for public security management if local services fail to adapt.
chinese: 如果地方服务未能及时适应，更大的人口流动可能给公共安全管理带来新的挑战。

english: An influx of young people into cities can increase demand for jobs and housing.
chinese: 大量年轻人涌入城市，可能增加对工作和住房的需求。

english: During a probationary period, employees may face uncertainty and financial risks.
chinese: 试用期间，员工可能面临不确定性和财务风险。

english: Repeated job changes may leave some workers overly critical and less tolerant of problems, while frequent changes in personnel can disrupt business and production.
chinese: 反复换工作可能使部分劳动者过于挑剔、对问题的容忍度降低，而频繁的人员变动也可能干扰业务和生产。

english: A more specialised division of labour can increase cooperation among different sectors.
chinese: 更加专业化的劳动分工，可以增加不同部门之间的合作。

english: The pressures of modern life and work may encourage family members to support one another more closely.
chinese: 现代生活和工作的压力，可能促使家人更加紧密地相互支持。

english: Pollution and overcrowding in cities can increase residents' stress.
chinese: 城市污染和过度拥挤可能增加居民的压力。

english: When both parents work to cover household expenses, they may rely on grandparents or babysitters to care for their children.
chinese: 当父母双方都工作以支付家庭开销时，他们可能依赖祖父母或保姆照顾孩子。

english: Living separately may reduce unnecessary conflicts caused by different living habits and generation gaps.
chinese: 分开居住可能减少因生活习惯不同和代沟而产生的不必要冲突。

english: People who enjoy time alone may be more motivated to learn how to solve problems independently.
chinese: 享受独处时光的人，可能更有动力学习如何独立解决问题。

english: Housing designs that emphasise private spaces may reduce opportunities for casual conversation between neighbours.
chinese: 强调私人空间的住宅设计，可能减少邻里之间闲聊的机会。

english: Campaigns for gender equality and female empowerment can help women become more self-reliant.
chinese: 促进性别平等和女性赋权的运动，可以帮助女性更加独立。

english: Part-time work during education can help young people become more economically independent and rely less on their parents for pocket money.
chinese: 求学期间的兼职工作，可以帮助年轻人更加经济独立，减少对父母提供零花钱的依赖。

english: Concerns about crime can increase people's wariness of strangers.
chinese: 对犯罪的担忧可能使人们更加提防陌生人。

english: A high frequency of petty crime can weaken residents' sense of security.
chinese: 轻微犯罪频发可能削弱居民的安全感。

english: People who feel stressed at work may have little time or energy left to go out and socialise.
chinese: 工作中感到压力的人，可能没有多少时间或精力外出社交。

english: Opportunities to study or work away from home can help young people develop independent living skills earlier.
chinese: 离家求学或工作的机会，可以帮助年轻人更早培养独立生活技能。

english: A highly competitive workplace may encourage employees to solve problems independently, although greater independence does not necessarily remove the need to expand their social circle.
chinese: 竞争激烈的工作环境可能促使员工独立解决问题，但独立性增强不一定意味着不再需要拓展社交圈。

english: In the information age, online resources enable people to complete many tasks independently with greater ease.
chinese: 在信息时代，网络资源让人们更容易独立完成许多任务。

english: Overdependence on technology may lead people to isolate themselves from one another.
chinese: 过度依赖技术可能导致人们彼此隔绝。

english: Digital services give people more recreational options without leaving home.
chinese: 数字服务让人们足不出户就拥有更多休闲选择。

english: Medical advances may help older people live longer and remain healthier, reducing their dependence on their children when suitable support is available.
chinese: 在具备适当支持的情况下，医学进步可能帮助老年人活得更久、更健康，并减少对子女的依赖。

english: Reduced interaction among relatives may leave family members with less assistance when problems or emergencies arise.
chinese: 亲属之间互动减少，可能使家人在遇到问题或紧急情况时得到的帮助更少。

english: A lack of social support can make mental health difficulties harder to manage.
chinese: 缺乏社会支持可能使心理健康困难更加难以应对。

english: Population ageing may require governments to allocate more funds to pensions.
chinese: 人口老龄化可能要求政府向养老金投入更多资金。

english: Expanding their circle of friends and spending time socialising can bring new energy to young people's lives.
chinese: 拓展朋友圈并花时间社交，可以为年轻人的生活注入新的活力。

english: When reporting social problems, the media should also provide factual information about possible solutions and progress.
chinese: 报道社会问题时，媒体也应提供有关可能的解决办法和进展的事实信息。

english: Traditional stereotypes portray men as assertive, adventurous, emotionally strong, driven, ambitious and physically strong, but these traits vary between individuals.
chinese: 传统刻板印象把男性描述为有主见、爱冒险、情感坚强、有干劲、有抱负且体格强健，但这些特征因人而异。

english: Stereotypes may portray women as submissive, stability-seeking, anxious or empathetic, but gender does not determine an individual's personality.
chinese: 刻板印象可能把女性描述为顺从、追求稳定、容易焦虑或富有同理心，但性别并不决定个人性格。

english: Traditional roles often assign earning money to men and household chores to women, whereas families can share both responsibilities.
chinese: 传统角色常把赚钱养家分配给男性，把家务分配给女性，而家庭可以共同分担这两类责任。

english: The assumption that men should take technical jobs and women should do clerical work can restrict individual career choices.
chinese: 认为男性应从事技术工作、女性应从事文职工作的假设，可能限制个人职业选择。

english: Gender divisions in the labour market can reflect unequal opportunities rather than differences in individual ability.
chinese: 劳动力市场中的性别分工，可能反映机会不平等，而非个人能力差异。

english: Where women are underrepresented in senior positions at global companies, employers should examine barriers to promotion.
chinese: 如果女性在跨国公司的高级职位中代表不足，雇主应审视晋升障碍。

english: Interpersonal, problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills should be assessed individually, while employers should address gender pay gaps and pregnancy discrimination.
chinese: 人际交往、解决问题和处理冲突的能力应按个人评估，同时雇主应处理性别薪酬差距和怀孕歧视。

english: Some stereotypes describe male leaders as straightforward and female leaders as supportive, but effective leadership can combine both qualities regardless of gender.
chinese: 一些刻板印象把男性领导描述为直接、女性领导描述为支持性强，但不论性别，有效领导都可以兼具这两种品质。

english: Some forms of production in agrarian and industrial societies are physically demanding, but job requirements should be assessed directly rather than inferred from gender.
chinese: 农业和工业社会中的某些生产活动对体力要求很高，但应直接评估岗位要求，而非根据性别推断能力。

english: Caring professions require sensitivity and sympathy, qualities that people of any gender can develop.
chinese: 照护职业需要敏感度和同情心，而任何性别的人都可以培养这些品质。

english: Traditional social contexts can shape expectations about gender roles.
chinese: 传统社会环境可能塑造对性别角色的期待。

english: Media portrayals of men and women as fundamentally different can reinforce accepted social norms rather than reflect every individual's experience.
chinese: 媒体将男性和女性描述为根本不同，可能强化既有社会规范，而不是反映每个人的经历。

english: Technological developments can reduce the physical demands of some jobs and create opportunities for women to become more independent.
chinese: 技术发展可以降低一些工作的体力要求，为女性更加独立创造机会。

english: Labour shortages provide an additional reason to remove barriers that prevent women from participating fully in the workforce.
chinese: 劳动力短缺提供了又一理由，促使社会消除妨碍女性充分参与工作的障碍。

english: Narrowing gender gaps in employment can promote economic development.
chinese: 缩小就业中的性别差距可以促进经济发展。

english: Older people can make significant economic contributions through taxation, saving and spending.
chinese: 老年人可以通过纳税、储蓄和消费作出重要经济贡献。

english: Many families, communities and organisations benefit from older people's skills, knowledge and experience.
chinese: 许多家庭、社区和组织受益于老年人的技能、知识和经验。

english: Some people continue teaching or conducting research beyond the official retirement age.
chinese: 一些人在法定退休年龄之后仍继续教学或开展研究。

english: Although ageist stereotypes portray older people as less energetic or enterprising, many provide care and support by looking after grandchildren, doing housework, shopping and running errands.
chinese: 尽管年龄偏见把老年人描述为缺乏活力或进取心，许多人仍通过照看孙辈、做家务、购物和跑腿提供照顾与支持。

english: Older people can serve as living repositories of knowledge, a role often associated with wisdom before the information age.
chinese: 老年人可以成为活的知识库，这一角色在信息时代之前常与智慧相联系。

english: Advances in contraception and medicine give people more reproductive choices, while accessible medical insurance can support timely treatment.
chinese: 避孕和医学的进步让人们拥有更多生育选择，而可获得的医疗保险可以支持及时治疗。

english: Greater health awareness may encourage habits that support a longer and healthier life.
chinese: 更强的健康意识可能鼓励有助于延长健康寿命的生活习惯。

english: Greater autonomy allows women to decide whether they want children, including choosing not to give birth.
chinese: 更大的自主权让女性能够决定是否要孩子，包括选择不生育。

english: Changing views of marriage and family have made remaining single or choosing a dual-income household without children more acceptable in some communities.
chinese: 婚姻和家庭观念的变化，使保持单身或选择双收入无子女家庭在一些社区更被接受。

english: Women seeking career advancement may be unwilling to give up their jobs when deciding whether to have children.
chinese: 追求职业发展的女性，在决定是否生育时，可能不愿放弃自己的工作。

english: Mounting pressures in urban life may make some people reluctant to raise children.
chinese: 城市生活中不断增长的压力，可能使一些人不愿养育孩子。

english: Rising urban housing costs and longer periods in higher education may delay marriage and childbirth, while an ageing workforce can contribute to labour shortages in some industries.
chinese: 城市住房成本上升和接受高等教育时间延长，可能推迟婚育，而劳动力老龄化可能加剧一些行业的人手短缺。

english: A shortage of skilled workers may weaken a country's international competitiveness.
chinese: 技术工人短缺可能削弱一个国家的国际竞争力。

english: People planning for longer retirements may spend less and save more, which can reduce demand in a consumption-driven economy.
chinese: 为更长退休期作准备的人可能减少消费、增加储蓄，这可能降低消费驱动型经济中的需求。

english: Greater demand for healthcare can put pressure on a country's health system if capacity does not expand.
chinese: 如果服务能力没有扩大，更大的医疗需求可能给一个国家的医疗系统带来压力。

english: Higher pension costs can place an additional financial burden on the state.
chinese: 更高的养老金成本可能给国家带来额外的财政负担。

english: More accessible public facilities can make a meaningful difference to older people's daily lives.
chinese: 更便于使用的公共设施，可以切实改善老年人的日常生活。

english: Communities can organise activities that teach older residents how to use electronic devices.
chinese: 社区可以组织活动，教老年居民使用电子设备。

english: Hospitals and nursing homes can provide professional care when families need additional support.
chinese: 家庭需要额外支持时，医院和护理机构可以提供专业照护。

english: Raising the retirement age may increase labour supply, tax revenue and consumer spending, but policies should consider differences in health and job demands.
chinese: 提高退休年龄可能增加劳动力供给、税收和消费支出，但政策应考虑健康状况和岗位要求的差异。

english: Welfare policies such as child benefits can lower the cost of raising children, while community programmes can invite elders to share personal histories and life experiences as cultural bearers.
chinese: 儿童津贴等福利政策可以降低育儿成本，而社区项目可以邀请长者作为文化传承者分享个人历史和人生经历。

english: Closer cultural and commercial links, together with less restrictive travel visa requirements, can make international tourism more accessible.
chinese: 更紧密的文化和商业联系，以及更宽松的旅游签证要求，可以让国际旅游更容易实现。

english: Improvements in cross-border transport can make international journeys faster and safer.
chinese: 跨境交通的改善可以让国际旅行更快捷、更安全。

english: Some members of the millennial generation are keen to travel abroad, although preferences differ within every age group.
chinese: 一些千禧一代成员热衷于出国旅游，但每个年龄群体内部的偏好都有差异。

english: Awareness that a destination is threatened may motivate people to visit before it changes, potentially adding pressure to a vulnerable place.
chinese: 意识到某个目的地正受到威胁，可能促使人们趁它改变之前前往，同时也可能增加脆弱地区的压力。

english: Travelling abroad can push people out of their comfort zone as they learn to navigate an unfamiliar environment.
chinese: 出国旅行可以促使人们走出舒适区，学会应对陌生环境。

english: A holiday can offer a break from the hustle and bustle and help people approach daily life with a different mindset.
chinese: 度假可以让人暂时远离喧嚣，以不同的心态面对日常生活。

english: Tourism can strengthen international connections and create opportunities for business and cultural collaboration.
chinese: 旅游可以加强国际联系，创造商业和文化合作的机会。

english: Learning about local values and norms can help visitors develop cultural sensitivity.
chinese: 了解当地的价值观和规范，可以帮助游客培养文化敏感性。

english: Tourism gives a country opportunities to present itself to the world and raise its international profile.
chinese: 旅游让一个国家有机会向世界展示自身，并提升国际知名度。

english: International travel can make local cultures and cuisines better known around the world.
chinese: 国际旅行可以让当地文化和美食更加为世界所知。

english: Visitors can celebrate a destination's distinctive culture while planning carefully for dietary restrictions and food allergies.
chinese: 游客可以欣赏目的地的独特文化，同时妥善考虑饮食限制和食物过敏。

english: Large volumes of tourist travel can exacerbate environmental pressures.
chinese: 大规模游客流动可能加剧环境压力。

english: Land and sea travel often involve fossil fuel consumption and associated carbon emissions.
chinese: 陆路和海路旅行常涉及化石燃料消耗以及相关的碳排放。

english: Hotels, heating, catering and transport can all affect the surrounding environment.
chinese: 酒店、供暖、餐饮和交通都可能影响周边环境。

english: Some tourism jobs are seasonal and insecure, with relatively low pay and limited skill requirements.
chinese: 一些旅游业岗位具有季节性且不稳定，工资相对较低，对技能的要求也有限。

english: Tourism businesses may exploit workers when commercial exchanges are not supported by effective labour protections.
chinese: 当商业交易缺乏有效劳动保护时，旅游企业可能剥削劳动者。

english: Excessive cultural commercialisation can undermine the core values of a tourist destination.
chinese: 过度的文化商业化可能损害旅游目的地的核心价值。

english: Holidaymakers may offend local communities if they behave disrespectfully towards other cultures.
chinese: 度假者如果不尊重其他文化，可能冒犯当地社区。

english: A growing advertising industry can create jobs and generate tax revenue for the government.
chinese: 不断发展的广告业可以创造就业机会，并为政府带来税收。

english: Some commercials introduce healthier dietary options, although consumers still need to assess the claims critically.
chinese: 一些商业广告介绍较健康的饮食选择，但消费者仍需审慎评估其宣传。

english: Advertising may raise ethical concerns when it promotes smoking, excessive drinking or a lifestyle centred on unrestricted consumption.
chinese: 当广告鼓吹吸烟、过度饮酒或以无节制消费为中心的生活方式时，可能引发伦理担忧。

english: Advertising high-fat and high-sugar foods may encourage dietary habits associated with obesity and diabetes.
chinese: 宣传高脂、高糖食品的广告，可能鼓励与肥胖和糖尿病相关的不良饮食习惯。

english: Large-scale competitive advertising may trigger an advertising war and increase companies' costs.
chinese: 大规模的竞争性广告可能引发广告战，并增加企业成本。

english: Small firms may face unequal competition because they cannot match large companies' advertising budgets.
chinese: 小企业可能面临不平等竞争，因为它们无法匹敌大公司的广告预算。

english: Heavy advertising by dominant firms may drive smaller businesses out of the market and increase the risk of monopoly.
chinese: 占优势企业的大量广告投放，可能将小企业挤出市场，增加垄断风险。

english: Poorly managed landfills can damage local ecosystems.
chinese: 管理不善的垃圾填埋场可能破坏当地生态系统。

english: Because advertising can create unrealistic wants among children, legislation may restrict advertisements aimed at them.
chinese: 由于广告可能在儿童中制造不切实际的欲望，法律可以限制面向儿童的广告。

english: Parents can use child-friendly settings on electronic devices to reduce children's exposure to inappropriate content.
chinese: 家长可以使用电子设备的儿童友好设置，减少孩子接触不适当内容的机会。

english: News coverage can educate people about health, the environment and other public issues.
chinese: 新闻报道可以帮助人们了解健康、环境和其他公共议题。

english: Consulting different news sources can help readers develop a fuller picture of an event.
chinese: 查阅不同新闻来源，可以帮助读者更全面地了解一件事。

english: Low-cost online news can attract readers and help businesses reach potential customers more quickly and easily.
chinese: 低成本的在线新闻可以吸引读者，并帮助企业更快捷、更容易地接触潜在顾客。

english: News outlets can spread art and culture by showcasing different cultural practices.
chinese: 新闻媒体可以通过展示不同文化实践，传播艺术和文化。

english: Digital media can expose users to impersonation, fraud and hacking if safeguards are inadequate.
chinese: 如果保护措施不足，数字媒体可能让用户面临冒充身份、诈骗和黑客攻击的风险。

english: News can be distorted, allowing disinformation to spread.
chinese: 新闻可能被歪曲，从而使蓄意虚假信息得以传播。

english: Compulsive media use can distract people and reduce their productivity.
chinese: 难以控制的媒体使用可能分散人们的注意力，降低生产效率。

english: Selective or misleading news can manipulate public opinion and discourage readers from questioning the message.
chinese: 选择性或误导性的新闻可能操纵公众舆论，使读者不愿质疑信息。

english: Long periods of screen use may cause eye strain, while listening at excessive volume can pose risks to hearing.
chinese: 长时间使用屏幕可能引起眼疲劳，而音量过大的收听可能危害听力。

english: Media habits that replace physical activity may encourage a sedentary lifestyle and increase health risks associated with obesity.
chinese: 如果媒体使用取代了身体活动，可能鼓励久坐生活方式，并增加与肥胖相关的健康风险。

english: Doom-laden headlines may attract attention by exaggerating the sense of danger.
chinese: 充满灾难色彩的标题，可能通过夸大危险感来吸引注意力。

english: Repeated exposure to alarming reports may instil negative feelings and nurture unnecessary fear.
chinese: 反复接触令人担忧的报道，可能带来负面情绪，滋生不必要的恐惧。

english: Coverage of private lives can influence people's behaviour, while repeated exposure to dominant cultural models may encourage cultural assimilation.
chinese: 对私生活的报道可能影响人们的行为，而反复接触占优势的文化模式可能促进文化同化。

english: As a traditional form of media, newspapers may enjoy public trust when they maintain reliable reporting standards.
chinese: 报纸作为传统媒体形式，如果保持可靠的报道标准，可能获得公众信任。

english: Informative newspapers can help readers examine social problems from different perspectives.
chinese: 信息丰富的报纸可以帮助读者从不同角度审视社会问题。

english: Detailed reporting can provide readers with valuable information.
chinese: 详尽的报道可以为读者提供有价值的信息。

english: Rigorous fact-checking can make reporting more authoritative and less misleading, although strict censorship does not itself guarantee accuracy.
chinese: 严格的事实核查可以增强报道的可信度、减少误导，但严格的信息审查本身并不保证准确。

english: Newspapers can help cultivate reading habits and support an informed public discussion.
chinese: 报纸可以帮助培养阅读习惯，支持建立在充分信息之上的公共讨论。

english: Not everyone has access to digital news, including some older people who face barriers to using technology.
chinese: 并非人人都能获取数字新闻，包括部分在使用技术方面面临障碍的老年人。

english: Extended screen time may cause headaches or fatigue for some readers.
chinese: 长时间看屏幕可能让部分读者感到头痛或疲劳。

english: Some readers find physical copies more comfortable to use than an impersonal electronic screen.
chinese: 一些读者认为，与缺乏亲切感的电子屏幕相比，纸质读物使用起来更舒适。

english: A reassuringly familiar newspaper layout can make information easier to find.
chinese: 熟悉且令人安心的报纸版式，可以让信息更容易查找。

english: Limited space in a newspaper can prevent detailed coverage of a complex event.
chinese: 报纸版面有限，可能妨碍对复杂事件进行详细报道。

english: Rigid media censorship can limit the public's access to information.
chinese: 严格的媒体审查可能限制公众获取信息。

english: Readers should be free to comment on social issues within rules that protect lawful expression.
chinese: 在保护合法表达的规则下，读者应能自由评论社会问题。

english: Printing newspapers can be costly.
chinese: 印刷报纸可能需要较高成本。

english: Many news reports can be accessed online without a direct charge to the reader.
chinese: 许多新闻报道可以在线获取，读者无需直接付费。

english: Digital media can spread information across geographical barriers more quickly than printed newspapers.
chinese: 数字媒体能够比纸质报纸更迅速地跨越地理障碍传播信息。

english: Excessive printing can waste paper and increase pressure on forests.
chinese: 过度印刷可能浪费纸张，增加森林所承受的压力。

english: Printing inks can pollute the environment if they are produced or disposed of improperly.
chinese: 如果生产或处理不当，印刷油墨可能污染环境。

english: Poorly controlled chemicals can contaminate soil and water resources.
chinese: 管理不当的化学物质可能污染土壤和水资源。

english: An inactive lifestyle can contribute to obesity.
chinese: 缺乏活动的生活方式可能增加肥胖风险。

english: Improved medical technology can help detect diseases earlier and support treatment that saves or extends lives.
chinese: 医疗技术的改善可以帮助更早发现疾病，并支持挽救或延长生命的治疗。

english: Agricultural technology can boost yields and help address food shortages.
chinese: 农业技术可以提高产量，帮助缓解粮食短缺。

english: Genetic modification can contribute to a wider range of crop varieties, although dietary diversity also depends on access and farming choices.
chinese: 基因改造可以增加作物品种，但饮食多样性也取决于获取条件和农业生产选择。

english: Automation can increase productivity while saving labour and time.
chinese: 自动化可以提高生产率，同时节省人力和时间。

english: Useful technologies can bring greater comfort to daily life and simplify routine tasks.
chinese: 实用技术可以使日常生活更舒适，并简化常规任务。

english: Overreliance on equipment can reduce efficiency when a breakdown interrupts work.
chinese: 当设备故障中断工作时，对设备的过度依赖可能降低效率。

english: Replacing some low-skilled jobs with machines can result in unemployment if workers cannot move into other roles.
chinese: 如果劳动者无法转向其他岗位，用机器取代部分低技能工作可能导致失业。

english: As technology becomes more affordable, Internet access can become more widespread.
chinese: 随着技术价格更可负担，互联网接入可以变得更加普遍。

english: Being able to furnish our own workspace may increase satisfaction with our surroundings.
chinese: 能够自己布置工作空间，可能提高我们对周围环境的满意度。

english: A sedentary lifestyle can increase the risk of health problems, including obesity.
chinese: 久坐的生活方式可能增加肥胖等健康问题的风险。

english: Digital systems can expose users to cyber-attacks, data fraud or theft, and misinformation.
chinese: 数字系统可能让用户面临网络攻击、数据欺诈或盗窃以及虚假信息的风险。

english: Remote work may reduce company costs while causing home life and working life to overlap.
chinese: 远程工作可能降低公司成本，同时使家庭生活与工作生活相互重叠。

english: Access to minerals or fuel sources in space might ease concerns about resource depletion in the long term, but practical extraction remains uncertain.
chinese: 长期来看，获取太空矿产或燃料资源或许能缓解对资源耗竭的担忧，但实际开采仍存在不确定性。

english: Space technologies, including satellite communications, positioning systems and remote sensing, can help monitor the Earth's fragile environment.
chinese: 卫星通信、定位系统和遥感等空间技术，可以帮助监测地球脆弱的环境。

english: Space migration is sometimes proposed as a response to overpopulation, but it is not a practical substitute for addressing population pressures on Earth.
chinese: 太空移民有时被提出用于应对人口过剩，但它不能实际替代解决地球人口压力的措施。

english: Space missions can collect research data and advance scientific understanding.
chinese: 太空任务可以收集研究数据，推动科学认识的发展。

english: Space research can stimulate innovation in related fields, including artificial intelligence and agriculture.
chinese: 空间研究可以激发人工智能、农业等相关领域的创新。

english: Exploration has long been a feature of human societies.
chinese: 探索长期以来一直是人类社会的一项特征。

english: Supporters see space exploration as a new stage in human development that can also create employment.
chinese: 支持者把太空探索视为人类发展的新阶段，认为它也可以创造就业。

english: Technologies adapted for space missions may benefit daily life, but claims about the origins of products such as dehydrated foods or cordless vacuum cleaners need careful checking.
chinese: 为太空任务改进的技术可能有益于日常生活，但脱水食品、无线吸尘器等产品起源于何处的说法需要仔细核实。

english: Satellites can extend telephone and Internet coverage to remote areas and provide data for weather forecasts.
chinese: 卫星可以将电话和互联网覆盖扩展到偏远地区，并为天气预报提供数据。

english: Large space programmes may be unaffordable for countries facing urgent development needs.
chinese: 对于面临迫切发展需求的国家，大型太空项目可能难以负担。

english: Space research can be time-consuming and deliver limited immediate results.
chinese: 空间研究可能耗时较长，且短期成果有限。

english: Space debris can threaten future spacecraft, and some material may fall back to Earth.
chinese: 太空碎片可能威胁未来的航天器，部分材料还可能落回地球。

english: More frequent launches can increase emissions and create additional environmental pressures.
chinese: 更频繁的发射可能增加排放，并带来额外的环境压力。

english: Hypothetical contact with another civilisation might challenge religious beliefs or cause culture shock, but claims that it would create social chaos are speculative.
chinese: 假设与另一文明接触，可能挑战宗教信仰或带来文化冲击，但断言这会造成社会混乱属于推测。

english: Accessible healthcare allows people with infectious diseases to receive prompt treatment.
chinese: 可获得的医疗服务，让传染病患者能够及时接受治疗。

english: Prohibitive medical costs can delay treatment and make infectious diseases harder to control.
chinese: 高得难以负担的医疗费用可能延误治疗，使传染病更难控制。

english: People in some less affluent areas have few affordable healthy food options.
chinese: 一些不富裕地区的人们缺少价格可负担的健康食品选择。

english: Unaffordable healthcare can deepen social and economic exclusion and harm society as a whole.
chinese: 无法负担的医疗服务可能加深社会和经济排斥，损害整个社会。

english: Some argue that access to essential medicines and treatment without financial barriers should be recognised as a basic right.
chinese: 有人认为，不受经济障碍限制地获得基本药品和治疗，应被视为基本权利。

english: Higher education can contribute to a nation's economic position, although it is not the only factor.
chinese: 高等教育可以影响一个国家的经济地位，但它并非唯一因素。

english: People from disadvantaged backgrounds may be unable to access higher education without financial support.
chinese: 缺少经济支持时，来自弱势背景的人可能无法接受高等教育。

english: A healthy population provides an important foundation for a prosperous economy.
chinese: 健康的人口为繁荣的经济提供重要基础。

english: During an epidemic, a healthcare system may face much greater pressure than usual.
chinese: 疫情期间，医疗系统可能面临远超平时的压力。

english: Governments should work to secure public healthcare coverage and provide access to high-quality services.
chinese: 政府应努力保障公共医疗覆盖，并提供获得优质服务的机会。

english: Unequal access to education can widen the gap between rich and poor.
chinese: 受教育机会不平等可能扩大贫富差距。

english: Appreciating art, music and literature can help people understand one another and lead more satisfying lives.
chinese: 欣赏艺术、音乐和文学，可以帮助人们相互理解，过上更充实的生活。

english: Scientific advances and their applications across many fields have improved the lives of many people.
chinese: 科学进步及其在多个领域的应用，改善了许多人的生活。

english: Science education can help citizens think independently and make evidence-based decisions, supporting a country's development.
chinese: 科学教育可以帮助公民独立思考、根据证据作决策，从而支持国家发展。

english: Critics may argue that free services weaken personal incentives or strain public resources, but claims that free healthcare makes people lazy require evidence rather than assumption.
chinese: 批评者可能认为免费服务削弱个人激励或挤压公共资源，但“免费医疗让人懒惰”的说法需要证据，不能仅凭假设。

english: Donor countries can grant scholarships that allow students from recipient countries to study abroad.
chinese: 援助国可以提供奖学金，让受援国学生获得出国学习的机会。

english: Medical aid can send experienced doctors to train healthcare workers in underprivileged areas.
chinese: 医疗援助可以派遣有经验的医生，培训贫困地区的医护人员。

english: Development assistance can help disadvantaged countries strengthen key industries.
chinese: 发展援助可以帮助处境不利的国家壮大支柱产业。

english: Military assistance is sometimes intended to support counter-terrorism and political stability, although its effects depend on context and accountability.
chinese: 军事援助有时旨在支持反恐和政治稳定，但其效果取决于具体背景和问责机制。

english: Well-designed aid can support a stronger economy, a healthier population, technological progress and employment opportunities in developing countries.
chinese: 设计良好的援助可以支持发展中国家改善经济、人口健康、技术进步和就业机会。

english: Maintaining positive international relations can help countries cooperate on pressing global problems.
chinese: 维持良好的国际关系，可以帮助各国合作解决紧迫的全球性问题。

english: Aid packages that include loans may increase the recipient country's debt.
chinese: 包含贷款的援助方案可能增加受援国的债务。

english: Foreign aid can be ineffective or counterproductive when bureaucrats and top-down planners face little accountability.
chinese: 如果官僚机构和自上而下的规划者缺少问责，外国援助可能无效甚至适得其反。

english: Aid that ends up in the pockets of a corrupt elite may fail to benefit the wider population.
chinese: 落入腐败精英口袋的援助，可能无法让广大民众受益。

english: Spending on overseas aid can leave fewer funds available for domestic welfare projects and job-creation programmes when budgets are fixed.
chinese: 在预算固定时，海外援助支出可能使国内福利项目和就业创造计划可用的资金减少。

english: Exploitative practices in the clothing trade can include low wages and poor working conditions.
chinese: 服装贸易中的剥削行为可能包括低工资和恶劣的工作条件。

english: Products such as convenience foods and disposable goods are designed for a more efficient lifestyle, but they may generate additional waste.
chinese: 方便食品、一次性用品等产品旨在提高生活效率，但可能产生额外垃圾。

english: Some renewable energy sources depend on environmental conditions, whereas fossil-fuel generation can be scheduled more directly, although it carries environmental costs.
chinese: 一些可再生能源依赖环境条件，而化石燃料发电可以更直接地调度，但会带来环境代价。

english: Non-biodegradable waste can cause serious problems for oceans and wildlife.
chinese: 不可生物降解的垃圾可能给海洋和野生动物带来严重问题。

english: Discarded rubbish can clog waterways and contribute to water pollution.
chinese: 被丢弃的垃圾可能堵塞水道并造成水污染。

english: Light pollution can disrupt animal behaviour, including bird migration and the activity patterns of nocturnal species.
chinese: 光污染可能干扰动物行为，包括鸟类迁徙和夜行动物的活动规律。

english: Environmental damage and hazards such as wildfires can cause economic losses, although distinct phenomena such as El Nino require separate explanations.
chinese: 环境破坏及山火等灾害可能造成经济损失，但厄尔尼诺等不同现象需要分别解释其成因。

english: Rising temperatures can contribute to sea-level rise, threatening land where people live.
chinese: 气温上升可能推动海平面上升，威胁人们居住的陆地。

english: Developing cultivated or plant-based meat may help reduce some environmental pressures from animal husbandry, depending on production methods.
chinese: 发展培育肉或植物基肉类，可能帮助减少畜牧业的部分环境压力，具体效果取决于生产方式。

english: Supporters of animal research cite contributions to medical breakthroughs, including vaccine development and organ transplantation, while its necessity must still be assessed in each case.
chinese: 动物研究的支持者援引其对疫苗研发、器官移植等医学突破的贡献，但每项研究的必要性仍应分别评估。

english: Where animal experiments are permitted, animals should be treated humanely and research methods should minimise suffering.
chinese: 在允许开展动物实验的情况下，应人道地对待动物，并通过研究方法尽量减少痛苦。

english: Feathers are used in bedding and clothing, including pillows and duvets.
chinese: 羽毛被用于床上用品和服装，包括枕头和羽绒被。

english: Studying how animals behave and learn can be interesting and may also teach us more about ourselves.
chinese: 研究动物如何行动和学习很有趣，也可能帮助我们更了解自己。

english: Animal husbandry can produce greenhouse gas emissions.
chinese: 畜牧业可能产生温室气体排放。

english: Without animals that act as pollinators, the production of many crops would face serious difficulties.
chinese: 如果没有充当传粉者的动物，许多作物的生产将面临严重困难。

english: Once suitable habitats have been restored or secured, animals may be gradually and carefully reintroduced into the wild.
chinese: 在适宜栖息地得到恢复或保障后，可以逐步、谨慎地将动物放归野外。

english: A declining economy and rising unemployment can increase social pressures, although they do not make criminal behaviour inevitable.
chinese: 经济衰退和失业率上升可能增加社会压力，但不会使犯罪行为成为必然。

english: An inadequate social welfare system may fail to provide financial assistance to people in need.
chinese: 不完善的社会福利体系可能无法向有需要的人提供经济援助。

english: Economic deprivation can contribute to the conditions associated with crime, but it is not a complete explanation of individual behaviour.
chinese: 经济匮乏可能加剧与犯罪相关的环境因素，但不能完整解释个人行为。

english: Brain injuries can affect behaviour in some cases, but they should not be treated as proof that someone will behave antisocially.
chinese: 脑损伤在某些情况下会影响行为，但不应据此认定一个人会出现反社会行为。

english: People whose basic needs are unmet may face greater insecurity and stress.
chinese: 基本需求未得到满足的人，可能面临更强的不安全感和压力。

english: Disadvantaged circumstances can put pressure on decision-making without determining how an individual will act.
chinese: 不利处境可能给决策带来压力，但并不决定个人会如何行动。

english: Conversations with former offenders about prison life may have a strong impact on young people, although their preventive value should be evaluated rather than assumed.
chinese: 前罪犯分享监狱生活的交流，可能深刻影响年轻人，但其预防效果应经过评估，不能想当然。

english: A more sympathetic approach may produce better outcomes when it addresses the reasons behind harmful behaviour.
chinese: 如果能够处理有害行为背后的原因，更具同情心的方法可能带来更好的结果。

english: Crime prevention may combine warnings about serious consequences with proportionate supervision.
chinese: 犯罪预防可以把对严重后果的警示与适度监督结合起来。

english: Rehabilitation can encourage offenders to reconsider their attitudes and reflect on the physical and psychological harm caused to victims.
chinese: 矫治可以鼓励犯罪者重新审视自己的态度，并反思给受害者造成的身心伤害。

english: Physical and mental activities can form part of rehabilitation, alongside support that helps former prisoners reintegrate into their communities.
chinese: 身心活动可以成为矫治的一部分，同时配合帮助出狱者重新融入社区的支持。

english: Opportunities to join work programmes can improve former offenders' chances of finding employment.
chinese: 参加工作项目的机会，可以提高曾经犯罪者找到工作的可能性。

english: Cultural records provide evidence of human achievements, although culture should not be used to dismiss the complex behaviour of other species.
chinese: 文化记录提供人类成就的证据，但不应借文化之名否认其他物种行为的复杂性。

english: Shared cultural practices can provide a vital connection among members of an ethnic group.
chinese: 共同的文化实践可以成为一个族群成员之间的重要联系。

english: Heritage can represent a country's distinctive history, culture and traditions.
chinese: 文化遗产可以代表一个国家独特的历史、文化和传统。

english: Historic buildings may be considered works of art as well as places with practical functions.
chinese: 历史建筑既可能被视为艺术品，也可能具有实际使用功能。

english: Cultural heritage can play a key role in maintaining and strengthening a nation's identity.
chinese: 文化遗产可以在维持和加强国家认同感方面发挥关键作用。

english: Places of worship may deserve preservation because of their cultural, historical and community value.
chinese: 宗教场所可能因其文化、历史和社区价值而值得保护。

english: The loss of endangered languages can make it harder for archaeologists and historians to interpret the cultures associated with them.
chinese: 濒危语言的消失，可能使考古学家和历史学家更难解读相关文化。

english: Distinctive cultural features can attract tourists and support local economic development.
chinese: 独特的文化特色可以吸引游客，支持地方经济发展。

english: Historic buildings can serve as tourist attractions and generate revenue for the local area.
chinese: 历史建筑可以成为旅游景点，并为当地带来收入。

english: Cultural assimilation and the relocation of economic activity may weaken local industries and force some businesses to close.
chinese: 文化同化和经济活动迁移，可能削弱地方产业，迫使一些企业关闭。

english: Traditional building techniques and materials can have significant research value.
chinese: 传统建筑技艺和材料可能具有重要研究价值。

english: A distinctive way of life may be lost when the language that carries it disappears.
chinese: 承载某种生活方式的语言消失时，这种独特生活方式也可能随之消失。

english: An endangered language remains a means of communication for the people who use it.
chinese: 对仍在使用它的人而言，濒危语言依然是一种交流方式。

english: Cultural homogeneity can make places less distinctive and reduce the variety of experiences available.
chinese: 文化同质化可能削弱地方特色，减少人们可以体验的多样性。

english: Communities can encourage donations from businesses and individuals by holding events in historic buildings and drawing attention to their value.
chinese: 社区可以在历史建筑中举办活动，吸引人们关注其价值，从而鼓励企业和个人捐款。

english: Linguists can document endangered languages by compiling dictionaries, recording histories and traditions, and translating oral stories.
chinese: 语言学家可以通过编纂词典、记录历史和传统、翻译口头故事，记录濒危语言。

english: Local language courses can help younger generations learn and pass on endangered languages.
chinese: 本地语言课程可以帮助年轻一代学习并传承濒危语言。

english: Non-profit activities can raise awareness of the importance of protecting historic buildings.
chinese: 非营利活动可以提高公众对保护历史建筑重要性的认识。

english: Outdated traditions, such as gender discrimination or unquestioning obedience to elders, can hinder the development of a fairer society.
chinese: 性别歧视或盲目服从长辈等陈旧传统，可能妨碍社会变得更加公平。

english: Living in poorly maintained housing can reduce people's standard of living and well-being.
chinese: 居住在维护不善的房屋中，可能降低人们的生活水平和幸福感。

english: Houses in poor condition can pose safety risks when repairs are neglected.
chinese: 如果忽视维修，状况不佳的房屋可能构成安全风险。

english: Dilapidated houses without significant historic value may damage a city's appearance if they remain neglected.
chinese: 没有重要历史价值的破旧房屋，如果长期无人维护，可能损害城市面貌。

english: Renovating old houses can require substantial public funding.
chinese: 翻修老房屋可能需要大量公共资金。

english: Tourism revenue can support heritage preservation, while media publicity can familiarise people with a culture and raise awareness of the need to protect it.
chinese: 旅游收入可以支持遗产保护，而媒体宣传可以让人们了解一种文化，提高保护意识。

english: An international workforce can help ease labour shortages associated with population ageing.
chinese: 国际劳动力可以帮助缓解与人口老龄化有关的人手短缺。

english: Cultural commercialisation may weaken traditions when market appeal replaces their original meaning.
chinese: 当市场吸引力取代原有意义时，文化商业化可能削弱传统。

english: Language barriers can contribute to social segregation if people lack opportunities and support to communicate.
chinese: 如果缺少交流机会和支持，语言障碍可能加剧社会隔离。

english: A one-sided account from a guide or another commentator may reinforce prejudice.
chinese: 导游或其他讲解者片面的说明，可能强化偏见。

english: Misunderstandings about cultural differences can fuel suspicion and discrimination when they are not challenged.
chinese: 对文化差异的误解，如果得不到纠正，可能滋生猜疑和歧视。

english: Perceived differences in group success can create friction and envy, particularly when people believe opportunities are unfair.
chinese: 群体成功程度被认为存在差异时，可能引发摩擦和嫉妒，尤其是当人们认为机会不公平时。

english: Poorly managed development can damage the local environment.
chinese: 管理不善的开发可能破坏当地环境。

english: Poorly managed tourism can leave communities with littered streets, polluted waterways, damaged habitats and increased fire risks.
chinese: 管理不善的旅游可能使社区面临街道垃圾、水道污染、栖息地破坏以及更高的火灾风险。

english: Cultural tourism can contribute to resource depletion when visitor demand exceeds local capacity.
chinese: 当游客需求超过地方承载能力时，文化旅游可能加剧资源耗竭。

english: Artworks can provide material for historical research and encourage related spending, such as purchases of souvenirs.
chinese: 艺术品可以提供历史研究材料，并带动购买纪念品等相关消费。

english: Governments can draw on tax revenue to support arts projects that require resources beyond private funding.
chinese: 政府可以动用税收收入，支持资源需求超出私人资助能力的艺术项目。

english: Some businesses invest in the arts to gain economic benefits.
chinese: 一些企业投资艺术，以获得经济收益。

english: Art can strengthen a company's distinctive identity through landscape and office design.
chinese: 艺术可以通过景观和办公空间设计，增强公司的独特形象。

english: Artists can share their experiences in public spaces to communicate the value of art and attract public attention.
chinese: 艺术家可以在公共空间分享经验，传播艺术价值并吸引公众注意。

english: Greater exposure to artistic activities can deepen public understanding and encourage investment in works of art.
chinese: 更多接触艺术活动，可以加深公众理解，并鼓励对艺术品的投资。

english: Mass media can help artists publicise their work and reach potential investors.
chinese: 大众传媒可以帮助艺术家宣传作品，接触潜在投资者。

english: Some benefits of the arts are intangible and difficult to quantify, but this does not mean that they have no value.
chinese: 艺术的部分益处是无形且难以量化的，但这不意味着它们没有价值。

english: Education should prepare a skilled workforce while teaching practical financial skills, including investment basics, tax calculations and informed spending decisions.
chinese: 教育应培养具备技能的劳动力，同时教授投资基础、税款计算和理性消费决策等实用理财能力。

english: Practical lessons can teach household skills and time management, helping students organise everyday life.
chinese: 实践课程可以教授家务技能和时间管理，帮助学生安排日常生活。

english: Schools can provide age-appropriate instruction in personal safety, self-defence and how to give first aid.
chinese: 学校可以提供适合学生年龄的个人安全、自卫和急救教学。

english: Career preparation can include professional etiquette, negotiating with clients and understanding workplace dress codes.
chinese: 职业准备可以包括职场礼仪、与客户谈判以及理解工作场合着装规范。

english: Marketing, management and creative thinking skills can help students adapt to a changing job market.
chinese: 营销、管理和创造性思维能力，可以帮助学生适应不断变化的就业市场。

english: Flexibility can help people respond to rapid changes, including developments in artificial intelligence and machine learning.
chinese: 灵活应变能力可以帮助人们应对快速变化，包括人工智能和机器学习的发展。
